evidence.reason: The new fix-PR path pushes the branch at line 603 before finalize_publication builds the PR body. At line 623 the code directly calls .replace on v['reason'] with no presence or string check. A missing or non-string reason therefore raises after the push and before pr_create_pending/publication state is persisted, so retries can reach the same failure. Validating verdict reasons during harvest and treating malformed reasons as terminal artifact failures is a routine correctness repair in existing publication/retry behavior.
